items.text: A large picture in an image pane no longer balloons the app's memory.
A viewer's markdown or code file is read off the GUI thread.
A viewer's pictures, stylesheets and scripts are found and read off the GUI thread: a document on a slow path no longer freezes the terminals beside it.
The doubled idle CPU in baseline-4 is box drift, not a code regression.
Previous and Next Pane show their shortcut again in the palette and menus: Win+Ctrl+[ / Win+Ctrl+].
